header.title: Resizable Panels
header.description: Splits an area into panes the user can resize by dragging a separator or with the keyboard. It's built from three pieces: `ResizablePanels` is the group, `ResizablePanel` each pane and `ResizableHandle` the separator between two panes. Sizes are percentages of the group and always add up to 100.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result and code instantly. Drag the separators, or focus them with Tab and use the arrow keys.
playground.paneBody: Drag the separator to change the size.

arrows.action: Move the separator by `keyboardStep` points (2% by default). Horizontal splits use ← and →; vertical splits use ↑ and ↓.

edges.action: Take the previous pane to its minimum or maximum size.

enter.action: Collapses or expands the `collapsible` pane next to the separator. Expanding restores its previous size.

doubleClick.action: Same as Enter, with the mouse.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Alternate `ResizablePanel` and `ResizableHandle` inside `ResizablePanels` and give the group a height with `height`. `defaultLayout` sets the initial sizes in percent and `minSize` keeps a pane from shrinking too much. The examples use this pane and these demo styles.

navigation.title: Navigation
navigation.body: Drag the divider. When the handle is focused, the arrow keys move it too.

canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.body: Sizes are percentages of the group. Pair it with ScrollArea when content overflows.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: `orientation="vertical"` stacks the panes top to bottom. The group needs a height (via `height` or from the parent) to split it; the separator switches to a row cursor and a horizontal grip.

editor.title: Editor
editor.body: In a vertical split, the group shares its height between the panes.

output.title: Output
output.body: The handle uses the row-resize cursor and a horizontal grip.

threePanes.title: Three panes
threePanes.description: You can use as many panes as you like, with a separator between each pair. Each separator only moves the two panes next to it. Here the inspector has `maxSize={40}`: it never goes past 40% no matter how far you drag.

list.title: List
list.body: Each handle only moves the two adjacent panes.

detail.title: Detail
detail.body: minSize keeps a pane from disappearing while dragging.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.body: maxSize={40}: it never takes more than 40%.

collapsible.title: Collapsible and nested
collapsible.description: With `collapsible`, a pane can close completely: drag below `minSize` and it snaps to `collapsedSize` (0 by default). Double-clicking the separator or pressing Enter collapses and reopens it. A group can live inside a pane to build IDE-like layouts; the nested one uses `height="100%"` to fill the pane.

files.title: Files
files.body: Collapsible pane. Double-click the handle or press Enter to close it.

editor.title: Editor
editor.body: Nested groups share the same tokens. Inner handles only resize their pair.

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.body: Also collapsible: double-click the handle above.

scrollArea.title: With ScrollArea
scrollArea.description: Panes clip overflowing content (`overflow: hidden`). To give a pane its own scroll, wrap the content in a `ScrollArea` with `height="100%"`. Resizing doesn't reset the scroll position. If the content has a background, use `min-height: 100%` instead of `height: 100%`: with `height` the background gets cut off when scrolling (this happens with any scroll container).

paragraphs: Each pane wraps its content in a ScrollArea, so overflow stays inside the split instead of growing the page.
Give the group a height. Panes have min-height 0, so the scroll viewport can shrink when you drag the divider.
The list on the left is longer than the frame. The mouse wheel moves it without affecting the article on the right.
Changing the ratio doesn't reset the scroll: each ScrollArea keeps its own position.
Give each ScrollArea a label so screen readers can name the region.

sizes.title: Separator thickness
sizes.description: `size` sets the separator thickness: `sm` (4px), `md` (6px, default) or `lg` (8px). The area that responds to the mouse is wider than the visible line, so it's easy to grab even with `sm`.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: Pass `layout` and `onLayoutChange` to drive the sizes from your state: the buttons write the same state the drag updates. `onLayoutChange` fires on every move, so you can persist the layout (for example in localStorage). Here `keyboardStep={5}` makes each arrow press move 5 points.

main.title: Main
main.body: The buttons write the same state the drag updates.

customization.title: Padding, separator and icon
customization.description: `padding` on the group applies the same inner spacing to every pane (token, pixels or CSS), and `padding` on a pane replaces it just there. `handleColor`, `handleHoverColor` and `handleThickness` change the separator for the whole group; on a `ResizableHandle`, `color`, `hoverColor`, `thickness` and `icon` change only that separator, and `gripStyle` styles the icon box.

shared.title: Shared padding
shared.body: padding={4} on the group maps to --gem-space-4.

override.title: Own padding
override.body: This pane uses padding={8}. The handle takes the group's Menu icon.

handle.title: Handle props
handle.body: icon, color, hoverColor, thickness and gripStyle on this separator only.

customIcon.title: Custom icon
customIcon.description: `icon` on `ResizablePanels` changes the icon of every separator, and on a `ResizableHandle` only that one. It accepts any node: gem-system icons or your own SVG. If the group switches orientation, `horizontalIcon` and `verticalIcon` pick an icon for each axis.

group.title: Group icon
group.body: The buttons swap the group icon; dragging still works.

withoutGrip.title: Without grip
withoutGrip.description: `withHandle={false}` hides the icon and leaves just a thin line. The separator is still focusable and responds to the keyboard.

end.title: B
end.body: When the separator is focused, the keyboard still works.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `isDisabled` on the group locks every separator and lowers the opacity; on a `ResizableHandle` it locks only that one. A disabled separator leaves the tab order and ignores mouse and keyboard.

mobile.title: Small screens
mobile.description: On narrow screens a vertical split with `size="lg"` makes the separator easier to touch. The separator uses `touch-action: none`, so the page doesn't scroll while you drag.

primary.title: Primary
primary.body: On small viewports a vertical split is easier to drag.

secondary.title: Secondary
secondary.body: The page doesn't scroll while you drag the separator.

end.title: End
end.body: The styles come from classes, not props.

header.title: ResizablePanels API
header.description: API reference for the ResizablePanels, ResizablePanel and ResizableHandle React components: props, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens, utilities and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import them from the main entry or from their subpath, which also exports the utilities. You can also use `ResizablePanels.Panel` and `ResizablePanels.Handle`; `ResizablePanelGroup` is an alias of `ResizablePanels`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: All three accept HTML attributes and forward them to their element: ResizablePanels and ResizablePanel use HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and ResizableHandle uses HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>. The separator's pointer, keyboard and double-click handlers run before the internal ones; if you call event.preventDefault(), the separator skips its action. ResizableHandle must be inside ResizablePanels.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.separator: Each separator has role="separator", aria-orientation and aria-controls pointing to the previous pane.
a11y.value: aria-valuenow reports the previous pane's size in percent, between aria-valuemin="0" and aria-valuemax="100".
a11y.keyboard: The separator is focusable with Tab. Arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End and Enter move it or collapse the pane.
a11y.label: The default accessible name is Resize panels. Change it with label, for example label="Resize sidebar".
a11y.labels: If a pane scrolls, set label on its ScrollArea to name the region. With as you can use aside, main or section.
a11y.touch: The separator uses touch-action: none and captures the pointer, so dragging works the same with mouse, pen or finger.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Group. Receives `className` and `classNames.root`. Has a border, radius and `overflow: hidden`.
rules.size: Applied according to `size`. Sets the `--gem-resizable-handle` thickness.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled` on the group. Lowers the opacity.
rules.resizing: Applied while dragging. Disables text selection.
rules.panel: Each pane. Receives the pane's `className` and `classNames.root`, plus the group's `classNames.panel`.
rules.handle: Each separator. Receives the separator's `className` and `classNames.root`, plus the group's `classNames.handle`.
rules.handleOrientation: Sets the cursor (`col-resize` or `row-resize`) and the enlarged mouse area.
rules.active: Applied to the separator while dragging. Uses the hover color.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: They're all defined on `.gem-resizable`, so you can change them from your own class such as `.gem-resizable.my-class`. The `padding`, `handleColor`, `handleHoverColor` and `handleThickness` props (and the separator's `color`, `hoverColor` and `thickness`) write them inline, so those can only be overridden with `!important`.

items.--gem-resizable-border: Group border color and default separator color.
items.--gem-resizable-radius: Group radius. Set by the `radius` class.
items.--gem-resizable-panel-padding: Pane inner spacing. Set by the group's or pane's `padding`; 0 by default.
items.--gem-resizable-handle-hover: Separator color on hover, focus or while dragging. Set by `handleHoverColor` or `hoverColor`.
items.--gem-resizable-panel-size: Current pane size in percent, written inline on each pane. Read-only: useful for size-dependent styles.

items.--gem-color-primary-500: Separator color on hover, focus or drag.
items.--gem-color-primary-700: Icon color on hover or focus.
items.--gem-space-{n}: Spacing scale used by `padding` when it receives a token.

utils.title: Utilities
utils.description: Only exported from `@gem-org/gem-system/resizable-panels`. Useful to compute layouts outside the component, for example when restoring a saved layout.

items.DEFAULT_MIN_SIZE: Default `minSize` of each pane, in percent.
items.DEFAULT_MAX_SIZE: Default `maxSize` of each pane, in percent.
items.resolveConstraints: Fills a pane's `minSize`, `maxSize`, `collapsible` and `collapsedSize` with defaults and clamps them between 0 and 100.
items.resolveInitialLayout: Computes the initial layout: uses `layout` when its length matches; otherwise uses `defaultSize` and splits the rest equally.
items.normalizeLayout: Clamps each size to its limits and scales the total to 100.
items.resizePair: Moves separator `handleIndex` by a number of points, respecting the limits of both neighboring panes.
items.toCssLength: Turns a number into pixels (`320` → `"320px"`) and leaves strings as they are. It's what `height`, `width` and `handleThickness` use.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: They also accept the HTML attributes of their element.

group.title: ResizablePanels
group.description: The group: sets the orientation, sizes and shared styling.

items.orientation: `horizontal` places panes side by side; `vertical` stacks them.
items.layout: Controlled sizes in percent, one per pane. Normalized to add up to 100.
items.defaultLayout: Initial sizes in percent (uncontrolled). Without it, panes share the space equally.
items.keyboardStep: Percentage points moved by each arrow press. `PageUp` and `PageDown` move 5 times this value.
items.height: Group height. A number is read as pixels and a string as CSS. Required for vertical splits unless the parent has a height.
items.padding: Inner spacing for every pane: token, pixels or CSS.
items.icon: Icon for every separator. Each separator's `icon` wins.
items.horizontalIcon: Icon for horizontal splits. Falls back to `icon`.
items.verticalIcon: Icon for vertical splits. Falls back to `icon`.
items.handleColor: Color of every separator (any CSS color).
items.handleHoverColor: Separator color on hover, focus or while dragging.
items.style: Inline styles. Merged with the group's CSS variables.
items.onLayoutChange: Fires on every drag or keyboard move with the current sizes.

panel.title: ResizablePanel
panel.description: Each pane: sets its size limits and inner spacing.

items.defaultSize: Initial size in percent. Used when the group has no `defaultLayout` or `layout`.
items.minSize: Minimum size in percent while expanded.
items.collapsible: Lets the pane close below `minSize` down to `collapsedSize`.
items.id: Element id, used by the separator's `aria-controls`. Generated when omitted.
items.padding: Inner spacing for this pane. Replaces the group's `padding`.
items.classNames: Per-slot classes. `root` is added to the pane.

handle.title: ResizableHandle
handle.description: The separator between two panes. Must be inside ResizablePanels.

items.label: Separator accessible name.
items.icon: Icon for this separator. Replaces the group's.
items.hoverColor: Color of this separator on hover or while dragging.
items.thickness: Thickness of this separator. A number is read as pixels.
items.classNames: Per-slot classes: `root` for the separator and `grip` for the icon box.
items.gripStyle: Inline styles for the icon box.
